meanEn.text: a type of computer technology which is concerned with making machines work in an intelligent way, similar to the way that the human mind works

485679.mnemonic: "AI"最常见的含义是“人工智能”，全称为("Artificial Intelligence"）。比如："The AI helps doctors diagnose diseases." (AI帮助医生诊断疾病)。你还可以说"AI software"（人工智能软件），"AI development"（人工智能发展），还有"AI research"（人工智能研究）和"AI algorithm"（人工智能算法）呢～🤖

sentence.en: He is playing chess with an AI robot.
sentence.cn: 他正在和一个人工智能机器人下象棋。
